edits.new:
Then no item carries a retention class, and rwb-case neither shows nor recomputes the class "ILG-STD" of the entry of 14 December 2026 10:15

  Scenario: AC12 A role without Case record R sees only the refusal in the ledger section (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-access contract mock returns a role for "U-2001" without Case record R
    When "U-2001" opens the ledger section of SCR-03 for "RW-2026-000301"
    Then the ledger section shows message MSG-P4-002 and nothing else, and no case fact is read

  Scenario: AC13 The retention class is not a field of the timeline and a slow ledger still returns the case events (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock does not answer inside the parameter timeout for "RW-2026-000301"
    When "U-2001" opens the timeline of "RW-2026-000301" with the ledger items selected
    Then the answer is 200 with the case event of 16 December 2026 11:00, carries no retention class field and holds no class value for any item
    Then the read does not fail and rwb-case recomputes no retention class

  Scenario: AC14 Calls without a valid credential or without Case record R are answered 401 or 403 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-access contract mock returns no valid credential for the call of "U-2001"
    When "U-2001" opens the timeline of "RW-2026-000301"
    Then the response is 401 with message Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P3-E2034-APP-AC14), nothing is returned and nothing is written
    Given the rwb-access contract mock returns a role for "U-2001" without Case record R
    When "U-2001" saves a call on "RW-2026-000301" with the Idempotency-Key "IDK-SYN-0301-01"
    Then the response is 403 with message MSG-P4-002, no append is called and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC15 A consumed call that fails or does not answer returns nothing and writes nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-access contract mock does not answer for "U-2001" over team "MTG-BKK"
    When "U-2001" opens the timeline of "RW-2026-000301"
    Then no case fact and no ledger item is returned, no ledger read is made and nothing is written
    Then the failed contract is named and its answer code is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P3-E2034-APP-AC15)
